definition: The group of words for the verdicts a rule can return on a house. Unjudged is among them, and it is never a pass.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`judgment` holds the verdicts a rule can return on a house, unjudged among them", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
